Welcome! I’m glad you’re here, because we’re about to explore something that can truly transform the way we lead—and connect with others. Have you ever felt stuck between wanting to be respected as a leader, and just wanting to be genuinely liked? What if you didn’t have to choose?
Together, we’ll dive into the heart of Radical Candor: Be a Kickass Boss Without Losing Your Humanity, written by Kim Malone Scott. This isn’t just another management book—it’s a guide to blending direct, honest feedback with real, personal care.
Imagine a world where you can challenge your team openly, but also show them how much you care. That’s the sweet spot Kim Scott calls “radical candor.” We’ll see how trust, open conversations, and even a little vulnerability can take teams to new heights.
Along the way, you’ll pick up practical tips and real-life stories that turn those tough, sometimes awkward, conversations into real opportunities for connection and growth. We’ll figure out how kindness and results can go hand in hand—and why you never have to lose your humanity to be effective.
So, as we set off on this journey together, get ready to discover how feedback, trust, and honest leadership can reshape not just your workspace, but your relationships as well. Let’s see how Radical Candor can help us all become kickass bosses—without losing what makes us human.
